# Town of West Fairlee municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 26; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Delsie Hoyt (Chair), Beverly Jo Ash, Stuart (Tiger) Bacon, Bree Carlson, and Bruce Durkee for West Fairlee's five-member board
Town of West Fairlee, Selectboard page: Delsie Hoyt, Chair; Beverly Ash; Stuart "Tiger" Bacon; Bree Carlson; Bruce Durkee

Town of West Fairlee, Warning for the 2026 Town Meeting (signed January 26, 2026): the warning is signed by the same five members. Maurice Eaton, who won a three-year selectboard seat on the March 2024 tally, is not on the current board -- he departed by an unpublished mechanism and is minted only as a justice of the peace

offices.title: Town Clerk
offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Town Clerk

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, Town Clerk page: Staci Sargent, Town Clerk; she also recorded the 2026 warning

Town of West Fairlee, Town Meeting Day election results tally (the tally the clerk's page links as the March 3, 2026 results is in fact the March 2024 tally -- it carries the 2024 presidential primary and is dated March 4, 2024; cited here as 2024 evidence only, divergence disclosed on #163): Staci Sargent was elected Town Clerk for a three-year term in March 2024

offices.title: Town Treasurer
offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Town Treasurer

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 161 (Town of West Fairlee): sec. 1: the Selectboard appoints the Town Treasurer through a nominating-committee process -- the office is appointed, not elected
Town of West Fairlee, Town Treasurer page: Joe MacPherson, Treasurer

offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, Tax Collector page: Staci Sargent, Collector of Delinquent Taxes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Board of Listers

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, Town Meeting Day election results tally (the tally the clerk's page links as the March 3, 2026 results is in fact the March 2024 tally -- it carries the 2024 presidential primary and is dated March 4, 2024; cited here as 2024 evidence only, divergence disclosed on #163): Kenneth Parrot was elected Lister for a three-year term in March 2024

Town of West Fairlee, Listers page: the listers' office contact is Peggy Burden, and the page states the town contracts an appraisal consultant to assist the Lister. Burden and Parrot may hold different seats of the three-member board or Burden may have succeeded Parrot; the third seat's holder is unpublished (divergence flagged on #163)

offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Board of Auditors

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, Town Meeting Day election results tally (the tally the clerk's page links as the March 3, 2026 results is in fact the March 2024 tally -- it carries the 2024 presidential primary and is dated March 4, 2024; cited here as 2024 evidence only, divergence disclosed on #163): Jennifer Williams was elected Auditor for a three-year term in March 2024; the other two seats' holders are unpublished -- stragglers

offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Cemetery Commissioners

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, Cemetery Commission page: Candy Malinoski, Chair; Jen Shatney; Darlene Cook; Bart Koop; Jason Johns. Peter Lange, who won a five-year seat in March 2024, is not on the current commission -- straggler

offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Library Trustees

sources.note: Town of West Fairlee, West Fairlee Public Library page, 'Trustees': Jillian Hatch, Chair; Rebekah Cadwell; Melanie Bacon; Caitlin Leonard; Sarah Molesworth

Town of West Fairlee, Town Meeting Day election results tally (the tally the clerk's page links as the March 3, 2026 results is in fact the March 2024 tally -- it carries the 2024 presidential primary and is dated March 4, 2024; cited here as 2024 evidence only, divergence disclosed on #163): a library trustee is elected by ballot in West Fairlee (Marcia Lange won a four-year seat in March 2024); Lange is not on the current board -- straggler. The four-year term against five listed trustees is flagged on #163

offices.title: Town Moderator
offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Town Moderator

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term; Christopher Pierce won the office on the floor in 2024 and the current holder is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of West Fairlee Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists three West Fairlee justices of the peace: Maurice "Chuck" Eaton, Jen Shatney, and Rebecca Wurdack

Town of West Fairlee, Justice of the Peace page ('Terms Ending 2027'): Chuck Eaton, Jennifer Shatney, and Rebecca Wurdak, with two vacancies on the five-seat slate; the certified listing's 'Wurdack' governs over the page's 'Wurdak.' Shatney is also a cemetery commissioner; one record carries both memberships

jp_election.name: Town of West Fairlee Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the winners of West Fairlee's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election: Maurice "Chuck" Eaton, Jen Shatney, and Rebecca Wurdack were elected; two of the five seats drew no winning candidate (the town's own justice of the peace page shows the two vacancies), so the winners list holds the three elected justices
